columns.h3: H3 cell index as a lowercase hex string (deck.gl H3HexagonLayer getHexagon)
columns.cell_id: H3 cell index as BIGINT (same cell as h3)
columns.shannon: Shannon diversity H' = -sum(p_i ln p_i) over species
columns.es: Hurlbert expected number of species in a random draw of 50 records, ES(50); NULL where n < 50

stats.note: one row per layer x key x decade x res x variable; n_cells counts cells with a non-NULL value (0 when all are NULL, e.g. es where every n < 50)

encoding: partition values are percent-encoded on disk by DuckDB (space = %20); fetch over HTTP with `url_path` (each % encoded as %25), or read with DuckDB hive_partitioning, which decodes them.
decade_note: decade = floor(date_year / 10) * 10; records with no year are excluded; indicators computed with the same SQL as idx_h3 / idx_h3_eov.

files.note: manifest of every parquet file except itself (HTTP cannot glob)
